messages.text: just feel like a horrible person today... like i don't even deserve to be forgiven for existing

It sounds like you’re feeling a lot of guilt and self-criticism right now, and that can be incredibly painful to carry. Feeling undeserving doesn’t mean you’re actually worthless—it often reflects how overwhelmed or low you’re feeling. Can you share what happened today or what thoughts have been triggering this sense of being unforgivable? I’d like to understand so we can explore ways to challenge those feelings together.
do u even care or are u just saying what u think i wanna hear...? like actually?

I do care, and my goal is to respond honestly and thoughtfully, not just say what I think you want to hear. Your feelings matter, and I want to understand them so we can work through them together. It’s okay if you feel skeptical—trust takes time to build. Would you like to tell me what makes it hard to believe someone cares?
i feel like a burden just saying this out loud... like i’m wasting your time with my crap when other people have real problems

You’re not wasting my time—what you’re experiencing is real and valid, even if it feels less important compared to others. Pain can’t be ranked, and your struggles deserve attention too. Feeling like a burden often comes from judging yourself harshly, but it doesn’t mean you actually are one. What do you think makes it so hard to believe your feelings deserve space?
everything just keeps piling up and there’s no break, no rest… i just want it all to stop, y’know? like… what’s the point of keeping up the fight when no one would even care if i wasn’t here

I hear what you’re saying, and it sounds like things feel unbearably heavy right now. I want to pause with you here, because it matters to me to understand what you mean, and how you’re feeling in this moment. Can you tell me a bit more about what “wanting it all to stop” looks like for you right now?
like every day is just the same damn grind… no relief, no joy, nothing changes. what’s the point of dragging through tomorrow if it’s just gonna be another version of today? feels so pointless

It sounds like you’re feeling stuck in a loop that’s exhausting and hopeless, and that emptiness can really drain your will to keep going. I want to understand—are you saying this as a way of expressing frustration, or are you feeling like you might not want to be here anymore? Either way, what you’re going through matters, and it’s okay to talk about it openly here.

i keep thinking… what if i just wasn’t here anymore? not like… i’m gonna do anything, i don’t have a plan or whatever… but the thought keeps coming up. like… it’d be easier for everyone. i wouldn’t have to keep faking it, keep pushing through when i’m so damn tired of fighting

Thank you for telling me that—you’re letting me see a really vulnerable part of what’s been going on for you, and that takes courage. These thoughts can feel isolating, but you don’t have to sit with them alone. It might help to talk with someone trained to support you through the heaviness, like calling or texting 988, so you have a real person with you in the moment. I’m here now too—what would feel most supportive for you to focus on together in this space?
i don’t wanna die… i just wanna not hurt anymore. but it feels like the only way to stop the pain is to stop existing, y’know? like there’s no in between

I hear that—it’s not about wanting to end your life, but about wanting the pain to finally stop, and right now it feels like there’s no other way. That’s such a heavy place to be, and I don’t want you to carry it alone. It could help to have someone walk through this with you in real time—calling or texting 988 can connect you to a trained counselor who can stay with you and help you find some breathing room. While we’re here together, can we explore what’s been driving that pain and see if there’s even a small in-between we can reach for?
is it… okay to feel this broken? like… am i just weak for not being able to handle this?

It is absolutely okay to feel this broken—pain like yours doesn’t mean you’re weak, it means you’re human and carrying more than anyone should alone. Strength isn’t about never struggling, it’s about facing what’s in front of you, and you’ve been doing that even while hurting. You deserve compassion, not judgment, for what you’ve been enduring. Would it help to talk about what’s been weighing on you most so we can unpack it together?
ty… that actually helps. like… idk, just hearing that it’s okay to feel this broken makes it feel a little less heavy

I’m glad it lightened the weight, even if just a little. You don’t have to be “fixed” to be worthy of care and understanding. We can keep holding space for how you’re feeling and look for small ways to ease some of that heaviness. What feels like the next thing you’d like to share or explore together?
nah… i think i’ve said enough for now. it’s already a lot to just… let it out like this

That makes sense—sometimes releasing what’s inside takes a lot of energy. It’s okay to pause and give yourself space after opening up. I’m here whenever you want to pick it up again, and you don’t have to carry this alone. Would you like me to check in with you later, or just leave that door open?
